draft.emotion: fidgety and quick, constantly anticipating the next problem
notes: To say 'I am nervous' before an event, Russians use a verb ('Я волнуюсь' or 'Я нервничаю'), not 'Я нервный' (which means having an irritable temperament).
Notice the silent-looking cluster 'рвн': all three consonants are pronounced.

draftBefore.emotion: fidgety and quick, constantly anticipating the next problem

faults.why: Missing the /v/ sound; the 'в' in 'нервный' is pronounced (/ˈnʲervnɨj/).
Direct calque of 'I am nervous'; Russians say 'Я нервничаю' or 'Я волнуюсь'.
Missing the crucial false-friend warning that 'I am nervous' is 'я волнуюсь/нервничаю', not 'я нервный'.
Missing the everyday sense 'stressful, nerve-wracking' (e.g., нервная работа) and anatomical 'nerve' (нервная система).
